name: Momenta Global Limited
summary: Momenta Global Limited operates as an autonomous driving solutions company in China. The company offers two solutions including solutions for mass-produced vehicles and solutions for Robotaxi services. The company provides original equipment manufacturers with advanced driving automation software solutions. The company's services include pre-production technical development services and post-production licensing services. It offers robotaxi services using mass-produced vehicles. The company also develops the Momenta Mainline Platform, a unified platform that crystallizes engineering experience through standardization, process integration and automation.
